item.title: Traffic Light sequence needs updating, 23rd November
item.description:
The Westbound traffic on the A40 at the traffic lights at Hatherley Road is held for quite a while after the Eastbound traffic is released. I suspect this is from when the Eastbound traffic would have had a right filter onto Hatherley road. Google Streetview shows this right turn has not been allowed since at least May 2009

item.title: Intermittent failure of the cycle crossing sequence, 23rd November
item.description:
There is an intermittent issue with the traffic light on the Southam lane pedestrian/cycle crossing where the cycle crossing button is pressed and then the process will cancel itself and the crossing light does not turn green, the red indicator light on the button then stops illuminating as if the crossing sequence has completed. This does not happen every time and I have not seen a pattern, only that there have been several occasions where the red button light goes out without the green crossing light coming on.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Southam Lane, Tewkesbury
Report on FixMyStreet
